items.text: For women booking at the service's six hubs, what is the incremental cost per additional woman attending eight or more antenatal contacts when a hub offers group care, compared with hubs offering individual care only, from 2024 to 2026?
items.population: Women booking antenatal care at the six community hubs, 2024 to 2026
items.intervention: Booking at a hub offering group antenatal care (from January 2025)
items.comparator: Booking at a hub offering individual care only, and the same hubs in 2024
items.outcome: Attendance at eight or more contacts and cost per woman booked; incremental cost per additional attender
items.setting: Maternity service with six community hubs

finer: Feasible with existing data and 60 analyst hours; interesting to the board; novel in combining costs and attendance; ethical as a service evaluation; relevant to the 2027 decision.
summary: One PICO question with an incremental cost-effectiveness ratio.
